units.source_text: 不一會兒，老師走進辦公室，大概是正好看完了吧，

en.t: Before long, the teacher came into the staff room, probably having just finished reading it,

units.source_text: 只見他滿臉通紅，高聲大笑，還隨手拿給其他老師看。看到這一幕時，

en.t: I saw his face turn bright red as he burst into loud laughter and immediately showed it to the other teachers. Seeing that,
I could not help feeling completely satisfied.

units.source_text: 我成功地扮演了別人眼中的淘氣鬼，成功地擺脫了「受人尊敬」的束縛。

en.t: I succeeded in playing the mischievous boy that others saw in me, and I succeeded in escaping the constraints of being respected.

units.source_text: 成績單上我所有的學科都是滿分10分，唯獨品行要麼是7分，要麼是6分，而這一點也成了家人的笑料。

en.t: On my report card, every subject was a perfect ten, but conduct alone was either a seven or a six, and that too became a joke in my family.

units.source_text: 其實，我的本性與淘氣鬼正好相反。

en.t: In truth, my nature was the exact opposite of a mischievous boy.

units.source_text: 那時，我已經從男傭和女傭身上領教了何謂可悲，並遭到了他們的侵犯。

en.t: By then, I had already learned from the male and female servants what sorrow meant, and I had been violated by them.
